description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a WebKit Web Extension for WPEFramework, including initialization, callback handling, and communication setup.

classes.name: PluginHost
classes.description: Handles initialization, deinitialization, and communication for the Web Extension, including callbacks for page creation, console messages, and request handling.

methods.name: GetConnectionNode
methods.description: Retrieves the connection node identifier based on environment variables.

methods.name: PluginHost::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Web Extension, sets up signals, and injects JavaScript into pages.

methods.name: PluginHost::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and shuts down the extension.

methods.name: windowObjectClearedCallback
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into newly created window objects.

methods.name: consoleMessageSentCallback
methods.description: Logs console messages from web pages to system log.

methods.name: userMessageReceivedCallback
methods.description: Processes messages received from web pages for tasks like setting headers or handling bridge object messages.

methods.name: didStartProvisionalLoadForFrame
methods.description: Handles frame load events, unloading JS bindings as needed.
